questions.question_text: A cuboid has a square base of side 10cm and a volume of 1200 cm3. Work out the height of the cuboid.
A is the point (2, 7). The point A is translated to the point B by the vector p + q. Find the coordinates of B.
Work out 3/4 \div 2 1/2. Give your answer as a fraction in its lowest terms.
A truck of length 10m passes a gate of length 2m. The speed of the truck is 8m/s. Find the time the truck takes to completely pass the gate.
Find the volume of a cone with radius 3cm and perpendicular height 8cm. Give your answer in terms of \pi.
A right-angled triangle has an adjacent side of length 14cm and an angle of 30\degree, with the opposite side being x cm. Work out the value of x.
A = 2\pi rh + 3\pi r^2. Rearrange the formula to write h in terms of \pi, r and A.
A, B and C are points on a circle. TA is a tangent to the circle at A. CA = CB and angle BAT = 70\degree. Work out the value of x.
When Jack sells a computer for $264 he makes a profit of 20%. Work out the price Jack paid for the computer.
y is inversely proportional to \sqrt{x}. When x = 9, y = 2. Find y in terms of x.
3 \log y = 2 \log x - \log w. Find y in terms of x and w.
In the diagram, the graph passes through the point (4, 2). Write down the equation of the graph.
Write as a single fraction in its simplest form. 1 / (x - 3) - 2 / x
